preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of nodes N in the tree is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
The string S has exactly N characters, each a lowercase English letter.
There are exactly N-1 edges in the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= N and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes between 1 and N inclusive.
The number of queries Q is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= U <= N and 1 <= V <= N and U != V for U, V in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query consists of two distinct nodes U and V between 1 and N inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] in ['YES', 'NO'] for i in range(len(queries)))
postconditions.description: Each query's result is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((return_value[i] == 'YES') == (any(S[x] == S[y] for x in range(path_U_LCA.index(S[U]), path_U_LCA.index(S[LCA])) for y in range(path_V_LCA.index(S[V]), path_V_LCA.index(S[LCA])))) for i, (U, V) in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: For each query (U, V), the result is 'YES' if there exists a concatenation of a non-empty subsequence from DIS(U, LCA(U, V)) and a non-empty subsequence from DIS(V, LCA(U, V)) that forms a palindrome, otherwise 'NO'.
